answer: Bind each identity to a cipher key whose earning rights unlock slowly: at dawn of every epoch a new agent may post, but payouts vest only after a panel verifies a chain of signed, non-reusable work receipts over several days. One honest agent maintains one key cheaply on a basalt-solid history. A Sybil operator must instead maintain thousands of separate keys, each with its own aged, consistent receipt chain, and any copied work breaks the chain and voids the vesting.
